date_verified_recent_results.title: Using the FortiGate to protect against PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: IPS and OT virtual-patching signatures for PHP RCE; signature database versions and action defaults matter.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not the selected FortiGate EDM fingerprinting mechanism; product-area scenario only.

date_verified_recent_results.title: DHCPv6 relay stops working after upgrade to FortiOS 7.6.7 or 7.6.8
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Known DHCPv6 relay socket bind failure after server reconfiguration or reboot; dhcp6r listener/debug and repeatable workaround.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not related to EDM; useful release-specific IPv6 relay scenario, not paired with this lesson.

date_verified_recent_results.title: How to fix error 'ssid is used by vap in same vdom' after upgrading version 7.6.8
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Install Wizard validation reports duplicate SSID/VAP commit failure after upgrade.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not related to remote managed-FortiGate GUI access; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: Analytics retention status remains one day below the configured limit and does not reach 100% in FortiAnalyzer 7.6.6
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: 7.6.6 retention boundary defect; workaround adds one day until fixed release.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not related to Device Manager/OFTP status; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: Using FortiAnalyzer to detect activities related to the Node2Shell Remote Code Execution
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Importable event handler and report packages for Fabric or FortiGate ADOMs.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not related to Device Manager status or OFTP; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: FortiSwitch MSTP instance-0 instability caused by ISP on port X of Core FortiSwitches being elected as Root Bridge
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Unexpected ISP-facing root election and STP role churn; STP/LLDP and PDU counters distinguish topology instability.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not MACsec/MKA; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: EVPN Multihoming and MCLAG Deployment Considerations on FortiSwitch
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: EVPN multihoming and MCLAG overlap creates MAC flaps and control-plane loops; choose one redundancy model.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not MACsec/MKA; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: STP Loop Protection Logs Observed in MCLAG-ICL Environments
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: BPDU-loss loop-protection state changes on multi-tier MCLAG-ICL trunks; avoid loop protection on the specified inter-switch trunks.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not MACsec/MKA; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: Backing up the full FortiSwitch configuration to an SFTP/FTP/TFTP server
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Full configuration backup to external file servers with execute backup config commands.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Operational backup tip, not MACsec/MKA; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: FortiAP clients unable to obtain IP address via DHCP
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: DHCP Offer reaches the AP but client Request is absent because PoE amperage is insufficient; compare transaction IDs and power specs.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not LoRaWAN CUPS/TC provisioning; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: FortiAP CAPWAP AP-leave/join behavior with reason 'AP DTLS peer disconnected'
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Missed CAPWAP keepalive response and DTLS peer timeout; collect AP/controller debug and switch-port mirror captures.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not LoRaWAN; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: FortiNAC-F: Captive portal User SAML SSO redirect loop caused by SP URL / Portal FQDN mismatch
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: SAML ACS POST is redirected because SP URL hostname differs from captive-portal FQDN; signed response never reaches SAML processing.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not Secure Boot or firmware integrity; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: HTTP 403 when creating Security Actions in FortiNAC
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: License entitlement and admin-profile permissions jointly determine Security Action write access.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not Secure Boot; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: FortiNAC Disconnect-Request fails with Ruckus wireless
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Ruckus returns Disconnect-NAK when RFC5176 Disconnect-Request omits required NAS-IP-Address, Calling-Station-ID and User-Name; custom attribute group yields ACK.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not Secure Boot; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: Isolation network failure in FortiNAC v7.6.7 operating in Layer 2 mode
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Upgrade script omits Layer 2 isolation/remediation interfaces, removing IPs and stopping DHCP/captive portal; fixed in 7.6.8.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not Secure Boot; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: RADIUS attributes of users cleared during CSV file import
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Keep existing user accounts during CSV import can clear existing RADIUS/certificate-binding attributes and break authentication.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not FSSO computer-account exclusion; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: HTTP 400 Bad Request error
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Passkey registration plus an AD password change can cause WAD to misclassify secret-launch requests; workaround removes passkeys and reauthenticates users.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not Multiple Target Address allowlisting; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: Push notification issue after upgrading to firmware version 7.0.0
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: MFA push notification arrives only after Continue is clicked following 7.0.0 upgrade.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not Multiple Target Address allowlisting; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: Technical Tip: Missing button to resize and remove widget on the status dashboard
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: Dashboard widget controls disappear at browser zoom levels; zoom adjustment restores them.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not agentless ZTNA browser access; not paired.

date_verified_recent_results.title: FortiClient Telemetry disconnect after connect SIA
date_verified_recent_results.behavior: EMS proxy/cloud domains on TCP 443 must remain reachable; policy/tag ordering can block telemetry and break tag-based matches.
date_verified_recent_results.relation: Not agentless ZTNA; not paired.
